prompt.alinti: You can now cut what Claude costs you by up to 42% without changing a single prompt.
That's because a quick question gets the same deep thinking as building a whole app, and it all comes out of your limit.
So someone made a free mod called Effortless, where the new Haiku 5.5 reads every prompt and picks the effort level automatically for you.
Then, quick questions get low effort, while hard jobs get high effort, and you never touch the setting again.
And get this, on real coding tasks, it cut Opus costs by up to 42% with every answer still right.
And it's completely free, just paste this link into Claude, and for the linked comment, save.
Comment “SAVE” and I’ll DM you the link to this free mod that cuts what Claude costs you.
